repackFeatures: Based on Middle.Earth.Shadow.of.War-CODEX ISO release: codex-middle.earth.shadow.of.war.iso (103,976,435,712 bytes)
2 DLCs included and activated: Sword Of Dominion & Champions of War
100% Lossless & MD5 Perfect: all files are identical to originals after installation (not counting 4KC/HRTP)
Middle-earth.Shadow.of.War.V1.0.Online.Fix-REVOLT available in NoDVD folder after installation, allowing you some limited online features via shared game account
4K Cinematics and High Resolution Texture Pack ripped and moved to separate downloads due to low demand, NOTHING re-encoded
Selective Download feature: you may skip downloading and installing of credits video, benchmark mode files and voiceover packs you don’t need
Significantly smaller archive size (compressed from 96.8 to 23.9~38.7 GB, depending on selected components)
Installation takes: ~45 minutes on 8-cores CPU; ~1.5 hours on 4-cores CPU; ~2.5 hours on 2-cores CPU
After-install integrity check so you could make sure that everything installed properly
HDD space after installation: up to 65 GB
You can select language in game settings, text and voiceovers serapately
Repack uses ZTool library by Razor12911
At least 2 GB of free RAM (inc. virtual) required for installing this repack

In Middle-earth™: Shadow of War™, nothing will be forgotten.
